    • createCompilerIssue

      protected CompilerIssue createCompilerIssue(Node node, String issueDescription, Throwable cause, CompilerIssue[] causes)
      Creates the CompilerIssue for use in abstract functionality. If not overriden, a DefaultCompilerIssue is used.
      Parameters:
      node - Node.
      issueDescription - Issue description.
      cause - Optional cause. May be null.
      causes - Optional cause CompilerIssue instances.
      Returns:
      CompilerIssue, with default implementation providing a DefaultCompilerIssue.
